requirements.title: A whole array is a named array or final array component with no appended subscript list
requirements.definition: A whole array is either a named array or a structure component whose final part-ref is an array component name, and no subscript list is appended. This distinguishes a whole array from an array element or array section, whose final or relevant part-ref carries subscripts or section subscripts under 9.5.3.1 and 9.4.2.

pending.named-array-no-subscript-list: PENDING positive-control source: declare INTEGER a(3) with distinct literals [2,4,6], reference a without a subscript list in an assignment or intrinsic inquiry, and use SUM(a)==12 or SHAPE(a)==[3] as the independent oracle. Non-vacuous because a(2) alone would produce literal 4, not 12 or shape [3].
pending.final-array-component-no-subscript-list: PENDING positive-control source: derived type with INTEGER component c(3), scalar parent obj, assign obj%c=[3,5,7], reference obj%c without a final subscript list, and use SUM(obj%c)==15 or SHAPE(obj%c)==[3] as oracle. Non-vacuous because component and whole-array selection are both required.
pending.not-element-or-section-with-subscript-li: PENDING contrast source containing a whole-array reference a and separate designators a(2) and a(1:3:2). Oracles are distinct literal element 4 and section SHAPE [2]/SUM 8, establishing that appending a subscript list changes classification; element and section semantics remain dependencies.

requirements.title: Whole array appearances designate all elements in executable constructs and the entire array in nonexecutable statements except equivalence sets
requirements.source: 9.5.2 p2 sentences 1-2, J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF154.
requirements.definition: A whole array variable appearing in an executable construct specifies all elements of the array. A whole array designator appearing in a nonexecutable statement specifies the entire array, except that an appearance in an equivalence set has the special effect specified by 8.10.1.4.

pending.executable-construct-all-elements: PENDING positive-control program shape: INTEGER a(3), b(3) with b=[10,20,30]; execute a=b or a=b+1 and check independent literal vector [10,20,30] or [11,21,31]. Non-vacuous because each element has a different expected value and the whole-array variable is the assignment target or source.
pending.nonexecutable-statement-entire-array: PENDING source plan using a whole array designator in a declaration-time nonexecutable context that admits an array designator without subscripts, with SHAPE or declared extent as the literal oracle. Non-vacuous because an element designator repair would change rank to scalar; ownership of that statement context remains with its clause.
pending.equivalence-set-exception-delegated: PENDING source-only dependency plan contrasting an EQUIVALENCE object using an unqualified nonzero-sized array name with a first-element designator. The independent oracle is the 8.10.1.4 source equation for first element identity; no storage reading, TRANSFER, address arithmetic, or execution value is proposed.

requirements.title: Assumed-size arrays may appear as whole arrays only as actual arguments when shape is not required
requirements.source: 9.5.2 p2 sentence 3, J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF154.
requirements.definition: An assumed-size array is permitted to appear as a whole array in an executable construct or specification expression only when it is an actual argument in a procedure reference that does not require the shape. The assumed-size declaration, absence of last-dimension shape, and procedure-reference requirements are owned by 8.5.8.5 and procedure/interface clauses.

pending.actual-argument-shape-not-required-permi: PENDING positive-control source: external or explicit-interface procedure dummy that can accept an assumed-size actual without needing shape, caller dummy INTEGER a(*), and a call p(a). The independent oracle is a literal scalar side effect or status set by the callee using only permitted element access; non-vacuous because the whole-array actual is the argument, not a copied scalar.
pending.executable-shape-required-context-restri: PENDING diagnostic-policy/source pair: assumed-size dummy a(*) appears as a whole array in an executable context that requires shape, such as whole-array assignment or SIZE/SHAPE-dependent operation. Repair only by passing a bounded explicit-shape array or by changing the context to a shape-free actual argument; repaired source has a literal result. Do not require a static diagnostic for runtime extent values beyond the source-known assumed-size predicate.
pending.specification-expression-shape-required-: PENDING diagnostic-policy/source pair: assumed-size dummy a(*) appears as a whole array in a specification expression whose evaluation requires shape. Repair by replacing with an explicit bound or with a permitted inquiry not requiring the assumed-size shape; literal bound oracle makes the repaired declaration non-vacuous.
